comments.author: Geez
comments.body:
if i used my and my alt's farm it would take approx 2 month's to produce enough spring water, to make enough seal, to make 200 - 300 of this.
the spring water needed to make the seal, is not dropped at any dungeon or found on any map or shipwreck - as far as i know.
spring water is pretty rare stuff, its rarely in company shop long and sell's for 20k - 30k each.
if i was determined and i was lucky enough to be able to find 2k spring water in comp shop. and if i ran Bordeaux dungeon for a day (white ore). and i port hop Caribbean and colony to buy silver, then it would cost maybe 3 - 4 days ant 45m - 65m to make 200- 300 ointments.
white alchemy ointment is never in the company shops , i've paid 1m each for the convenience of not having to rely on luck to make 200 of this.

comments.author: Francine
comments.body:
Geez is pretty spot on, as an master alchemist I would pay upwards of 2-3 mill for these. Veracruz for silver (+gold for later use) then syracuse for mandrake+ salts to make the seals of sorcery. (either excess salts+spring water or barcelona for more salt since im spanish to make the undine seals)

Then go collecting at newfound land for white ores.

To make 200of these you would need:

200 Spring water
2000 white ores
3400 salts
1600 mandrake
1200 silvers.
Without great success's

Factor in po's time and effort to produce them. Good luck finding them for 500k, its the equilivant of buying qmp's for 250k.

Just sayin..
